outcome: frequency and volume of red blood cell (RBC) transfusion
frequency and volume of fresh-frozen plasma transfusion
frequency and volume of platelet concentrate (PC) transfusion
frequency and volume of fibrinogen administration
cohort: 595 participants with blood loss ≥ 1000 mL during vaginal delivery or ≥ 2000 mL during cesarean delivery
finding: Fibrinogen levels ≤ 1.5 g/L may have similar potential to a DIC score of ≥ 8 points for detecting obstetrical DIC in Japan.
